title.zh: 将苏丹库达拉特省卡拉曼西格镇卡拉曼西格中央实验学校的名称变更为Datu Guiabar纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Kalamansig Central Pilot School in Kalamansig, Sultan Kudarat, to Datu Guiabar Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Kalamansig Central Pilot School in Kalamansig, Sultan Kudarat, to Datu Guiabar Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6700_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Kalamansig Central Pilot School in Kalamansig, Sultan Kudarat, is hereby changed to Datu Guiabar Memorial School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
